diagnosis: developer_api_quota_view caches per-account developer usage statistics using @cache_page(120) without varying on the session cookie. When Developer A checks their quota, their application name, API key prefix, and quota usage are cached and returned to any other authenticated developer requesting the endpoint within the 2-minute cache TTL.
exploit_request:
GET /api/developer/quota/ HTTP/1.1
Host: developer.cloudapi.net
Cookie: sessionid=third_party_dev_session
Accept: application/json
